I feel bad for not being able to follow Ayane as she actually looked a little distressed just now...or at least as distressed as someone can look with a blindfold over their face.
I’m sure she’ll be fine, though. She’s competing against Yasu after all.
And even if she and Ami are at odds right now, I can’t imagine Ami doing anything that would make it harder to prevent additional girls from coming to my house.
That said, I’m trying to think forward for a change. And it definitely doesn’t have anything to do with the fact that I am now being encouraged to watch high school girls strip for me.
And in other completely unrelated news, I think I’m finally coming around to this year’s Dorm Wars.
I just hope Makoto makes it back to see this soon as I not only would like to share in this experience with her, but I’m worried I may have fucked her so hard that she actually died.
And that would be a pretty depressing ending to all that the two of us have managed to build together.
Fitting, sure.
But definitely depressing.
: Miku, did you see where I put my- holy shit. Never mind.
: Your what? I don’t even- oh, damn.
I’m going to stop staring at the sky now because it appears that something is happening and I’m beginning to feel a little left-
scene beachgravure1
Oh.
Oh, wow.
You know, I’ve tried my hardest to not think about having sex with Wakana.
I still do, of course. I just try to do it in moderation as I appreciate our friendship and also don’t want her girlfriend to kill me.
But right now? In this very moment? I think I am willing to risk death.
: Yo, the fuck you think you’re going? We told you to stay put.
: I’m being lured in by the song of a siren.
: That’s probably just the whambulance since you’re such a little bitch, bro.
: Hey, I actually liked that. Nice one, Tsuneyo.
: My name is Noodle Girl. Please continue to call me Noodle Girl.
: Can you two go become friends somewhere else so I can hit on someone my own age for once?
: No can do, cockmunch. We got a fuckin’ job to do and I ain’t about to hear Chika bitch at me for the rest of eternity.

Being surrounded by attractive and suspiciously-well-endowed-for-their-age girls has never been so difficult before...but I will accept my place in this circle of life and live vicariously through a horny bisexual couple.
scene beachgravure2
: Can I help you?
: Yes. I...I need help with English.
: What-
: All of it.
: You, uhh...you...
: I am going to stop you right there and say that I am not only taken but so disinterested in both of you that I would sooner quit romance entirely than even consider you as partners.
scene beachgravure3

scene beachgravure5

: Disgusting.
scene beachgravure6

scene beachgravure7
: Wow...I...I had no idea Miss Watabe...even owned an outfit like that. She looks absolutely beautiful.
scene beachgravure8
: How do you feel about this, Nodoka? You’re already her biggest fan, aren’t you?
: Nodoka?
scene beachgravure9
: Ah! Just how hard do you need to fall on the sand for it to make that noise?!
: T...Testing. Testing. One...Two...Three...
: Four...Five...Six...
scene clearnightsky
: Seven...Eight...
: Sis, are you gonna count all fucking night or can we start this thing already?
: I’ve never done this before! I don’t know how long I’m supposed to count for or...or why I’m even supposed to count in the first place.
: Should we come out yet?!
: In a minute! Karin is being Karin again!
: Who else am I supposed to be?!
: Laaaadiiiiies aaaaaand Sensei!
scene beachgravure10
: We are the Kanda sisters! And since almost half of our class isn’t here right now, there’s no one left to do this commentary but us!
: Do you guys really do this every year?
scene beachgravure11
: Great question, co-host Karin. We all know this isn’t your first trip to the Dorm Wars as you have assisted in judging at least one contest where Miku wound up licking me-
: I regret nothing!
: But you still don’t understand just how important this contest is, do you?
: No. And I also don’t understand why it suddenly involves modeling swimsuits for your teacher when I’m like 99%% sure that is against the rules.
scene beachgravure12
: Why it involves what?
: Is that what’s going on here right now?
: Sis, if you get this cancelled, I will disown you...
: Arakawa! What is the meaning of this?
: Hey, Wakana. You look-
: Never mind. I’ll ask Imani instead. Imani!
: Yes, Master Watabe?!
: Did you approve this?
: Reluctantly!
: She didn’t really put up much of a fight.
: But I didn’t endorse it either!
: You two are lucky I came. This stupid competition is one thing, but there is no conceivable way that a swimsuit modeling contest with high school girls is anywhere even close to being-
scene beachgravure13
: Fuck it! First contestant, come on out! Before Miss Watabe shuts this whole operation down!

: Go Chika, go! And don’t worry about modeling too hard and trying to take it easy on me! Hit me with your best shot! Please!
scene beachgravure14
: You got it, Uta. And may the hottest girl win.

: Taking the stage now is first floor representative, Chika Chosokabe!
scene beachgravure15

: Well...isn’t it...color commentary?
: Booooooo!

: Well, damn girl! I was booing the joke but now I’ve got a new bone to pick with you!
: Hellooo. Excuse me. Trying to be hot right now.
: More like...succeeding at...wait, no. I don’t want her to misunderstand and think that I’m looking at her in a romantic kind of-
: Completely ignoring my innocent sister, it’s time to start asking some questions and learning more about our contestants! So, Chika!
: Yes, bitch?
: Hmm...well, I was going to ask you something normal like, “What’s your favorite color?” or “What’s been on your playlist lately?”
: But since you wanna fire shots at a lowly commentator, why not just tell the class how many dicks you’ve sucked this week?
: Kirin!
: We’re all getting fired. I need to find a new job.
scene beachgravure16
: Yeah, like...I’m not really into that?
: Oh? Are you saying you prefer us girls instead?
: Of course not. I’m just trying to focus on other things right now. Like...saving up money. Taking care of family...That kind of stuff.
scene beachgravure17
: Plus, I’m a “one man” kind of girl. And while I’m definitely, totally, 100%% single at the moment...I can promise you that any man I would date...would be well taken care of.
: Can you two-
: Absolutely fucking not. Tsuneyo, get a cage before this pervert attacks a contestant.
: I will not fall for this. Nor do I know where I would locate a cage on such short notice.
scene beachgravure18
: Question two! Where do you see yourself in ten years and why is it Sensei’s bed?
: Do I get to ask a question as well? Cause I would kind of like to know why you keep projecting instead of reading the questions off of the cards like you’re supposed to.
: We have cards? Where are- oh! Cards! But what’s-
: Kirin, the questions on these cards are so much better and less gross! Why are you...the way you are?! Chika, I’ll read one.

: Question two! Where do you see yourself in- wait, that’s the same exact question Kirin asked.

: Oh my fucking god! Just let her answer the question without the Sensei part I tacked on! Jesus!
: Arakawa, I hate your class.

scene beachgravure19
: Hmm...ten years...
: I think that might be a nice age to start having kids, so...maybe a fancy apartment in Dotonbori with a baby in my lap? Preferably a mute one with darker skin and heterochromia.
: Here we go again.
: Dotonbori? You believe we’ll be allowed outside the barrier in ten years?
scene beachgravure20
: One can only hope. One of my biggest wishes is for war as a whole to come to an end...and for peace to reach every corner of Kumon-mi.
: Hello, Google? This is Kirin. I’m gonna need a copy of Chika’s search history to confirm how many times she looked up answers to basic ass beauty pageant questions.
: Shush. I thought her answer was wholesome and delightful. Chika wins!
: But I haven’t even gone yet! That’s not fair!
scene beachgravure21
: Question three! If you got to take any three celebrities to a deserted island for the indefinite future, who would they be and why?
: Oh, yay. You actually managed to-

: I’m so disappointed in you.

scene beachgravure22

: Well, I’d obviously have to take Niki Nakayama because she’s a huge inspiration of mine. And if there is anyone out there who’d know how to keep the mood up, it would be her.

: I would take Tom Holland and Zendaya since they’re my favorite celeb couple and would be able to repopulate.
: You just want Tom Holland to blow your back out, don’t you?

: But my first priority would always be the safety of all of us. Being stranded on a desert island would be an extremely scary experience, so maintaining a positive attitude would be all that-

Well, then...
Which girl do I think is the winner?
